{{Quote|We only need Ahsoka and her team to divert the Separatists' attention&mdash;and make them think that our main force is ''behind'' them. Then we'll add to their confusion by hitting them from the front&mdash;and they'll be ''crushed'' like an insect caught between a child's palm and a duracrete wall!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Night Moves!" />}}
A '''battle''' took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeenada]].

==The battle==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded [[Zeenada]], establishing a base on the planet. The Republic deployed the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].

[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] [[Gunner (501st Legion)|Gunner]] and [[Sarge (clone trooper)|Sarge]] created a diversion behind enemy lines, while Skywalker and Tano led the main attack against the droid army. The Separatists were surprised and the Republic gained the upper hand. During the battle, Tano drew a [[swamp monster]] from the jungle to intercept the enemy. The battle ended in a Republic victory.
